webster.text: Auction; a public sale of any thing by outcry, to the highest bidder.

example.quote: It may happen, for instance, that if ready money cannot be im mediately received from the pockets of individuals for their taxes,' their estates, consisting of lands, negroes, stock, and furniture, must be set up and sold at vendue.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 4, North Carolina Convention, Mr. SPENCER, July 26, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
